annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dirayati, F.; Sukardi, D.; WA, A.R.; Maulina, T.
key_provisions_or_claims: Indonesia needs national legal protection arrangements for AI and robots, focused on patent law.
Compares Indonesian Patent Law No. 13/2016 with US Patent Act and Japanese Patent Law.
USPTO confirmed in 2020 that AI cannot be an inventor under US patent law.
Patent protection for AI requires algorithms/programs to show AI-specific techniques.
Notes risks of robot-committed harms in Society 5.0 and need for human-rights-oriented regulation.
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper examining whether Indonesia needs national legal protection for AI and robots, focusing on patent law. It compares Indonesia's Patent Law No. 13/2016 with US and Japanese patent law using normative and comparative methods, concluding that AI inventions need clearer regulation.
annotation.title_clean: National Legal Protection Of Artificial Intelligence And Robots In The Era Of Industrial Revolution 4.0 And Society 5.0
